text: 据沙特方面4日消息，沙特与叙利亚当天签署国防部间合作协议，具体内容尚未公布。协议在叙利亚过渡政府总统艾哈迈德·沙拉访问沙特首都利雅得期间签署，沙拉当天会见沙特王储兼首相穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼，这是不到一个月内两人第二次在沙特会面。叙利亚上月开始审慎权衡向沙特提供军事援助，也门胡塞武装持续向沙特发动导弹和无人机袭击，沙特正向美欧及中东多方寻求攻防支持。按多家媒体说法，双方还签署了涉及基础设施、能源、住房、医疗卫生、工业、农业、环境和金融服务等领域的其他协议和谅解备忘录。叙利亚过渡政府财政部4日表示，沙特阿拉伯发展基金会当天与该部签署6项协议，将提供总额超过4
text_en: According to Saudi sources on the 4th, Saudi Arabia and Syria signed a defense ministry cooperation agreement that day, with specific details not yet announced. The agreement was signed during a visit by Syrian transitional government President Ahmed al-Sharaa to the Saudi capital Riyadh. Al-Sharaa met with Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman that day, marking the second meeting between the two in Saudi Arabia in less than a month. Syria began carefully weighing the provision of military assistance to Saudi Arabia last month. Yemen's Houthi forces continue to launch missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, and Saudi Arabia is seeking offensive and defensive support from the US, Europe, and multiple Middle East parties. According to several media outlets, the two sides also signed other agreements and memoranda of understanding involving infrastructure, energy, housing, health care, industry, agriculture, the environment, and financial services.
